privacy: We collect information you send when requesting information, purchasing a service, or connecting an account, plus technical data needed to operate and protect the service.
We use your data to provide support, process payments, run contracted automation, and improve security and performance.
We may use infrastructure, payment, analytics, and messaging providers under their own privacy terms. We do not sell personal data.
You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by emailing contacto@allok.fun.
terms: Each service is governed by the accepted proposal or plan, which defines deliverables, timing, price, and responsibilities.
Project payments are made by milestone. Subscriptions renew until canceled through the customer portal.
You may not use the services for fraud, abuse, spam, or activities that violate rights or applicable laws.
After agreed payments are complete, you receive the access and deliverables stated in the proposal. Third-party tools retain their own licenses.
For legal or commercial support, email contacto@allok.fun.
